title: tic data / capital flows / foreign holdings | Data Release Other | Treasury International Capital Data for February
summary: The U.S. Treasury released February 2026 TIC data showing a net TIC inflow of $184.5 billion, driven primarily by private foreign inflows of $166.5 billion versus official inflows of $18.0 billion. Foreign private investors purchased $147.3 billion in long-term U.S. securities while foreign official institutions sold $46.1 billion, with foreign residents increasing Treasury bill holdings by $91.6 billion.
